column2: Steam branch of the game, installed or updated on every start: public (the stable game, default), unstable (the beta), an older version such as 42.19, or legacy41 (Build 41), as listed under "Betas" in Steam.
Check Steam for a game update on every start (true/false, default true). With false an installed game starts as it is.
Admin account name created on the first start (default: admin).
Admin account password. Required on the first start, when the server creates its database; ignored afterwards.
File holding the admin password; takes precedence over ADMINPASSWORD.
Workshop item and collection IDs separated by ';'. Collections are expanded and written to WorkshopItems. Set it empty to clear WorkshopItems.
Steam Web API key, only needed to expand private or unlisted collections in WORKSHOP_IDS and for list-mods to list each item's required items.
Sandbox preset (a file name in media/lua/shared/Sandbox) used to create the SandboxVars file when it does not exist.
Overwrite an existing SandboxVars file with SERVERPRESET on every start (true/false).
Refuse to start when an INI_ or SANDBOX_ variable matches no setting or has a value of the wrong type (true/false).
Java heap size, for example 4096m or 8g. Sets both -Xms and -Xmx.
Start with a soft reset (true/false).
Start the server in debug mode (true/false).
Start as a coop server instead of a dedicated one (true/false).
Start without Steam, for non-Steam clients (true/false).
Mod folder search order, for example workshop,steam,mods.
Address the server binds to.
Main UDP port (default 16261).
Second UDP port (default 16262).
Steam port 1.
Steam port 2.
Enable Valve Anti-Cheat (true/false).
Locale for the server, for example en_US.UTF-8. Must be installed in the image (see the EXTRA_LOCALES build argument).
